title: Review by ear
description: The question, a pause for the answer and the check are available in a sequential audio session.

blocks.text: On the move people want to review material without reading a screen the whole time.

quote.text: It would be nice if it had a feature to read the flash cards to you like quizzlet does. It’s really nice to listen to while driving since you can just listen to the flash cards.

blocks.text: Choose the deck and the voice, let the pause before the answer be adjusted and the card replayed. For a first version, listening you can control is enough; speech recognition adds a separate job and a separate set of errors.
Decide what the audio is for

One user just wants to listen through the material, another wants to answer before the prompt. Both are valid, but an answer that was listened to should not automatically be marked as recalled unaided.
